item.title: FIFA World Cup schedule: When are matches?
item.description: The 2026 FIFA World Cup is just 100 days away as of Tuesday, and the eastern United States features five of the 16 host cities.New Jersey's MetLife Stadium will host eight World Cup matches, including the final. Philadelphia will host six, including a Round of 16 match on the Fourth of July. Boston is hosting seven games, including one of the quarterfinal matches. item.title: Dog killed in I-495 stabbings belonged to the suspect, Virginia State Police say
item.description: Officials say the man accused of stabbing four people on I-495 in Fairfax County, killing one, also stabbed his own dog to death. The suspect was shot and killed by a Virginia State trooper following the stabbings. Virginia State Police say at approximately 1:20 p.m. on Sunday, March 1, troopers responded to exit 52 on I-495 southbound in Fairfax County for a road rage incident. item.title: George Washington University signs nearly $500M deal with Amazon to build AI hub
item.description: George Washington University has closed a nearly $500 million deal with Amazon Data Services, selling its Virginia Science and Technology campus. The site could become Amazon’s next AI hub.Officials say it means jobs and new revenue, but some neighbors are fed up with data centers popping up near their homes.Amazon has not confirmed its plans for the property.
